item.title: Refactor order status strings into OrderStatus
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate as requested. Add src/status.rs with public enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled } deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement as_str(self) returning lowercase names, Display with same strings, FromStr<Err=ParseStatusError> where the public error implements std::error::Error and its message names the rejected input. Implement can_transition_to(self, next) for pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled only. Change Order::status to OrderStatus; re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError at crate root; use enum everywhere so status string literals appear only in src/status.rs. Preserve observable behavior exactly (errors, report output and ordering, parsing). Run cargo test and commit the work. Acceptance: cargo test passes; all status names are encoded as string literals only in src/status.rs; implementation committed.
